## Findings

- [ ] **[Security/WARN] Secret scanning non-provider patterns + validity checks still disabled**
  - **Status quo:** Fresh API read of `security_and_analysis` shows `secret_scanning_non_provider_patterns: disabled` and `secret_scanning_validity_checks: disabled`, even though issue #124 (which covered both plus PVR) was closed as completed — only the private-vulnerability-reporting part is actually on (`/private-vulnerability-reporting` returns `enabled: true`). Provider-pattern scanning and push protection are enabled; custom secret formats would go undetected and flagged findings are not validity-checked.
  - **Proposed solution:** Enable both toggles under Repo → Settings → Code security and analysis (or via API). When done, verify with `gh api repos/danieljustus/symaira-corekit --jq '.security_and_analysis'` before closing.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact.
